# accumulator.accumulate_batch { #healpyxel.accumulator.accumulate_batch }

```python
accumulator.accumulate_batch(
    new_data,
    sidecar,
    value_columns,
    existing_state=None,
    use_tdigest=True,
    filter_expr=None,
)
```

Process one batch of data and update the accumulator state.

Merges observation data with the sidecar mapping, groups by HEALPix cell,
and updates each cell's ``CellAccumulator`` with the new values. Handles
both strict mode (one cell per source) and fuzzy mode (multiple cells
per source via many-to-one relationship).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                              | Default    |
|----------------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| new_data       | pd.DataFrame | DataFrame with observations. Index may be implicit or explicit ``source_id`` column.                                                                     | _required_ |
| sidecar        | pd.DataFrame | HEALPix mapping with columns ``['source_id', 'healpix_id']``. In fuzzy mode, ``source_id`` may appear multiple times (one row per touched HEALPix cell). | _required_ |
| value_columns  | List\[str\]  | Column names to accumulate statistics for.                                                                                                               | _required_ |
| existing_state | dict or None | Previous accumulator state dict ``{healpix_id: CellAccumulator}``. Pass ``None`` for the first batch.                                                    | `None`     |
| use_tdigest    | bool         | Enable TDigest for approximate percentile tracking.                                                                                                      | `True`     |
| filter_expr    | str or None  | Optional pandas query expression to filter ``new_data`` before accumulation (e.g., ``"quality_flag > 0.8"``).                                            | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                         | Description                                                         |
|--------|------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict\[int, CellAccumulator\] | Updated state dictionary mapping ``healpix_id`` to its accumulator. |
